d: Peppino, people, sailors, Orientals, monks, Gondolisi, soldiers, sailors, merchants of all kinds. Then Pappacoda, finally Annina. When the curtain rises, there is a lively people's life. It is a busy evening. Above the scene is yellowish-red light, as it goes on the twilight. On the banks of the canal a gondola is laid, which a lady goes out, makes the purchases and then continues. From the barque lying on the shore, wood is loaded. Around Pappacoda's stand stand and sit some ragged companions who eat macaroni. Peppino, a small, greasy boy, serves them. The cheerful poppacoda is a young Neapolitan: in his outer half Lazzaroni, half cook; he has frizzy hair, brown complexion, wears earrings and around the neck an amulet, is very chatty and stinged on the most vivid.
Previous. Annina Annina, a fisherman girl, decorated with corals and shells of all kinds, carrying a net filled with frutti di mare over her shoulder, descends from a bark laid backwards
Delacqua, Testaccio, Barbaruccio three equally dressed, funny looking older men,people in the background

Previous. Agricola, Constantia, Notbierga, Macedonia, Teodolinda and other senatorial women, Balbi lets the ladies who wear masks, but are unmasked, enter. At the top comes Agricola, a fat old lady, who is still very lively
The duke comes from the left. Annina quickly takes her larva before her face.
Annina. Giboletta. Duke. Girl The Duke comes with Annina and Ciboletta; both wear stylized dove costumes. From the arcades come some girls, also dressed as pigeons
